headline: AI-driven deals lifted profit and revenue for most majors, but growth slowed at the top tier.
summary: Most Indian IT firms posted double‑digit revenue growth, led by Coforge's 53.6% surge and HCLTech's 11.5% rise. Profit growth was uneven; HCLTech and Coforge saw strong upside, while Infosys and Wipro posted modest or declining earnings. Guidance trended lower or remained flat, reflecting cautious outlooks. AI revenue contributions were highlighted across the cohort, but few disclosed exact figures.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI‑led deals and revenue jumps, with HCLTech reporting $219 m AI revenue and LTM noting a 47% AI revenue rise.

themes.title: Margin pressure at larger players
themes.detail: Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and posted a 21% operating margin, lower than TCS's 24% and Coforge's 16% after a raise.

themes.title: Dividend continuity
themes.detail: Most companies maintained or modestly increased interim dividends, signalling cash‑flow stability.
